integration_overview.topology: point-to-point, one differential pair per direction (TXP/TXN, RXP/RXN)
integration_overview.replaces: the parallel 10-bit GMII data path between MAC and PHY
integration_overview.init_sequence: Bring up SerDes; align on /K28.5/; run Clause-37 Auto-Negotiation exchanging /C/; PHY drives speed/duplex/link, MAC ACKs; on LINK_OK pass GMII data with x100/x10/x1 octet replication.
